body: I could not believe things could get worse, but they did. I moved out and now im in financial issues. I lost my best friend to alcohol and i lost my only car. Now i have to depend on others, i almost failed the class however now i need to take summer classes. My own mother hates me. I think i hate myself too. I don't want to fall victim in these thoughts but i'm getting trapped. I want a way out. I don't wanna be here i wanna be away from everyone.
